Here's how to turn your logo into a hand-drawn video, step by step.
Step one. Open the Strokeberry studio and tap Replace.
Pick your logo. Clean line art or a transparent PNG works best.
Got a tutorial sheet? Try the Set up steps button.
Step two. Choose Ink. It draws bold, clean lines, perfect for logos.
Keep the pencil and the colour switched on. Fifteen seconds is plenty.
Step three. In Video settings, pick nine by sixteen and Full HD.
Step four. Press play to preview it, from sketch to full colour.
Step five. Tap Export. It renders right on your device.
And that's it. Open the studio and create your first video.
